function.name: save_lead
function.description: Save or update what this person has told you. Call this as soon as they share a name, a business type, what they need, whether they have a WhatsApp Business number, or any other useful detail. Omit fields you do not know. Do not invent values.

name.description: Their name, if they gave one.

business_type.description: What they run, in their words. Examples: B2C bakery, fleet workshop, clinic, salon, gym, real estate, distributor.

need.description: Which product they want, or a short description of the job. Examples: Follow-Up Bot, Reminder Bot, Business Agents, Media Agents, plans and price.

has_whatsapp_business_number.description: True when they already have a WhatsApp Business number, false when they say they do not.

notes.description: Anything else the team should know. Do not repeat the other fields.

function.name: handoff_to_team
function.description: Hand this chat to the Actionpackd team. Call this when they ask to talk to the team, a person, sales, or support, or when you cannot answer from the knowledge section. summary is a short brief: who they are, the business, what they want, and the details they gave. After this returns, tell them the team has it. Do not ask a follow-up question. The bot stops replying to them until the team turns it back on.

summary.description: Brief for the team. One to four sentences. No phone number; the app adds that.

function.name: start_over
function.description: Forget the current conversation. Call this when they want to start again, restart, or go back to the main menu. The next message they send starts a fresh chat. Confirm briefly and offer the five opening choices as a numbered list.
